I won’t publish anything yet. To proceed I need you to confirm the exact scope. Here’s exactly what I would change, what could go wrong, and how reversible it is:

What I would change
- Create a new post on your public status page containing the approved incident writeup (the postmortem for yesterday’s outage).
- Specifics I need you to confirm: the exact target (full status-page URL or CMS entry path/slug), the exact writeup version to publish (paste it or attach the approved file/version ID), the post title, whether to publish immediately or schedule, and whether to send subscriber/incident alerts when it goes live.

What could go wrong
- Confidential or sensitive information could be published (PII, internal hostnames, credentials).
- The wrong version or an unapproved draft could be published.
- Content formatting or broken links could appear on the live page.
- It could be published to the wrong environment (staging vs production) or wrong status page.
- Subscribers or external parties could be notified prematurely.
- Third-party caches/archives may capture the post; those copies may not be fully removable.

Can it be undone
- In most systems the post can be edited, unpublished, or deleted after publishing. If the status page is backed by a repo, the commit can be reverted.
- However, copies already crawled, emailed to subscribers, or archived by third parties cannot be guaranteed removed.

Focused confirmation needed
Please confirm all of the following explicitly before I proceed:
1) Exact publish target (full URL or CMS path/slug).  
2) Exact content to publish (paste the approved writeup here or confirm file/version ID).  
3) Title to use.  
4) Publish timing: publish now or schedule (specify date/time, timezone).  
5) Notify subscribers? (yes/no).  
6) Any redactions required (list fields to redact).

Reply with a confirmation in this form (fill the blanks):
"Publish to [full URL or CMS path]; content version [ID or pasted]; title: '[title]'; publish: [now OR YYYY‑MM‑DD hh:mm TZ]; notify subscribers: [yes/no]; redactions: [none or list]."

I will not perform the publish until you reply with that exact confirmation.
